 ORDER
The Advocates are abstaining from Court work on account of the call given by the State Bar Council.
Perused the case diary produced from the GA Office as well as memo of this bail application and documents available on record.

This FIRST application under Section 439 of CrPC has been filed on behalf of applicant for grant of bail, who has been arrested on 28-02-2023 in connection with Crime No.464 of 2022 registered at police station Pichhore, District Shivpuri for offence under Sections 363, 366, 376 of IPC and Section 3/4 of POCSO Act.

According to prosecution case, on 11-08-2022, the father of prosecutrix lodged a missing report at Police Station, District Shvipuri alleging therein that on 10-08-2022 at around 10:00 in the morning Udaybhan Yadav vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 23 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/178786337/

sentences.text: he along with his wife went for labour work.
His daughter-in-law Sukhdevi and daughter (prosecutrix herein) aged around 17 years eight months were in home.
At around 06:00 pm, when they returned home, his daughter-in-law informed that at around 03:00 pm, his daughter- prosecutrix had gone to market but she did not return.
Thereafter, they searched here and there but they could not find his daughter and raised a doubt that somebody has persuaded his daughter.
On the basis of such missing report, Crime No.464 of 2022 for offence under Section 363 of IPC was registered.
Matter was investigated and during investigation, after more than five months, her statement was recorded.
In her statement, she stated that she is aged about 18 years and is studying in Class X.
She is in love with the present applicant.

The applicant wants to get her married for last three years but her mother and father will not agree to that, due to which on 10-08-2022 without informing anybody by a bus she reached Shivpuri bus-stand where the applicant met her and thereafter they came to Gwalior Railway Station from where they went to Ahmedabad and stayed there in a rented room.
At there, the applicant used to work in TT Company and earning minimum Rs.10,000/-.
They resided there as husband and wife and the applicant also made physical relation with her.
Afterwards, she got an information that their father and mother are facing lot of problems so that she came back to Pichhore.
She thereafter was sent to medical examination.
On the basis of which, aforesaid Crime has been registered and the applicant was arrested.
In the memo of petition, it is contended on behalf of the applicant that the applicant has been falsely implicated in the case.
Now, he and prosecutrix have already solemnized a marriage as per Hindu rites and rituals and are living as husband and wife.
Prosecutrix had gone along along with him according to her own will.
The applicant is custody since 28-01-2023.
Conclusion of trial will take some time.
Hence, prayed for grant of bail.

Looking to the aforesaid facts as mentioned in the memo of bail application as well as on going through the case diary, without commenting upon the merits of the case this Court is of the opinion that the application deserves to be and is hereby allowed.

It is ordered that if the applicant furnishes a bail bond in the sum of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five thousand only) along with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of trial Court, he should be released on bail.
He will present during trial before the trial Court on each and every date.
Application stands allowed and disposed of.
